about: Remake of the 11s intro of a 'Mushoku Tensei Jobless Reincarnation Episode 1' recap video (30fps). Footage frames come from the reference map; these are the frames it cannot match. Built 2026-09-24 against: ./amv.sh reference VIDEO --seconds 11. Their channel watermark is not reproduced; the caption's typo (REINCARTION) is fixed. The green-eye shot (9.47-9.6s) is not in S1 - the ep20 logo shot's own rays stand in.

overrides.about: 6.77-6.83s: the creature's last frame blurs, then flashes to white speed lines
6.87-7.13s: punch into the library from 3x on the cheek, RGB split fading out; source runs ~1.2 frames per output frame
9.47-9.53s: in place of the eye, the logo shot's rays, back from where the map picks it up

grade.about: the logo's navy background pushed to near-black, golds kept
